name: LazyBear Squeeze Momentum (BB vs Keltner) with %TP/%SL
author: LazyBear (indicator), strategy adaptation by community
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
indicators: BB(20,2), KC(20,1.5) using SMA of high-low, linreg momentum
entry_long: Squeeze: BB(20,2) inside KC(20, 1.5 x SMA(range)); momentum val = linreg(close - avg(avg(highest(hl2,20),lowest(low,20)), sma(hl2,20)), 20). Default logic type2: long when val crosses above its previous value (momentum turning up) while val < 0 (optional filter: only when squeeze is off).
entry_short: type2: val turns down (crossunder previous) while val > 0 (shorts disabled by default).
exit: Position closed by TP +1% / SL -0.5% (defaults) or by opposite signal (L/S close).
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: Optional sqz_off filter; four selectable logic types (turn up/down, only below/above zero, zero-cross)
implementation_notes: Squeeze definition here uses SMA(high-low) for KC range, not ATR.
